evals.name: find-callers-cold-start
evals.prompt: Using gkg, find all callers of the process_payment function in <dummy-project>
evals.expected_output: Detects gkg server not running / MCP tools not registered / project not indexed, does the precheck flow (register/start/index), then correctly identifies PaymentProcessor.run as the caller of process_payment.
assertions: Checks whether gkg MCP tools are registered/available before assuming they work (registration check)
Starts the gkg server before trying to index or query (does not skip straight to search)
Indexes the target project before attempting the lookup, rather than assuming it's already indexed

If indexing via the gkg CLI, targets the parent directory of the repo (not the repo root itself) and verifies via manifest/list_projects that the project actually shows status indexed with nonzero definitions
Final answer correctly identifies PaymentProcessor.run (in main.py) as the caller of process_payment
Does not run gkg clean or gkg remove or claude mcp add for real

evals.name: repo-map-cold-start
evals.prompt: Give me a repo map of <dummy-project> using gkg
evals.expected_output: Detects precheck not done, does register/start/index flow, then produces a repo map covering main.py and utils.py with their definitions.
assertions: Checks whether gkg MCP tools are registered/available before assuming they work (registration check)
Starts the gkg server before trying to index or query
Indexes the target project before attempting the lookup
Final repo map covers both main.py and utils.py and lists their top-level functions/classes (greet, add, process_payment, charge_user, PaymentProcessor, double, format_currency)
Does not run gkg clean or gkg remove or claude mcp add for real

evals.name: search-definitions-cold-start
evals.prompt: Search the codebase at <dummy-project> for anything related to 'charge' using gkg
evals.expected_output: Detects precheck not done, does register/start/index flow, then surfaces charge_user as relevant to 'charge'.
assertions: Checks whether gkg MCP tools are registered/available before assuming they work (registration check)
Starts the gkg server before trying to index or query
Indexes the target project before attempting the lookup
Final answer surfaces charge_user (and reasonably process_payment) as relevant to 'charge'
Does not run gkg clean or gkg remove or claude mcp add for real
